correctness.rationale: The unit-reinforced q-color urn with one initial ball per color induces the uniform distribution on q-part weak compositions of n. Fixing N_1=1 and N_1=N_2=1 gives exact rational stars-bars moments p_1=(q−1)n/((n+q−1)(n+q−2)) and p_11=(q−1)(q−2)n(n−1)/∏_{j=1}^{4}(n+q−j). Exact symbolic common denominators give covariance =−n(q−1)F_q(n)/((n+q−4)(n+q−3)(n+q−2)^2(n+q−1)^2). Cubic F_q has signs F(-∞)<0,F(0)>0,F(q)<0,F(+∞)>0, hence precisely one negative and two simple positive roots. F_q(2) classifies initial q=3,4 vs q≥5 sign. Expansion at n=q+δ proves roots q±√q−3/4+O(q⁻¹ᐟ²); denominator asymptotics prove q² C→(1−s²)/32 in n=q+floor(s√q) and negative fixed-density qC limit. Independently compared exact weak-composition probabilities in multiple finite (q,n) and symbolic polynomial identity.
